en.headline: Cornershop Busking Festival returns to Tsim Sha Tsui with free local music
en.dek: The free Saturday series at The Cornershop on Hart Avenue opens today with an afternoon gathering followed by two evening sets of Hong Kong artists.
body: The Cornershop Busking Festival returns to Tsim Sha Tsui today, bringing free live performances by local musicians to a street-level space opposite Mondrian Hong Kong on Hart Avenue.

Organised by Mondrian Hong Kong, the series runs across four Saturdays in November: the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th. Today’s programme begins with an opening gathering from 5pm to 6pm, where participating artists are expected to perform short interactive sets. Regular performances then follow from 6pm to 8pm with Vinky BB, and from 8.15pm to 10.15pm with Kamiel and Ka Long.

Later Saturdays feature other local acts including J Hei, Be, Tung Tung with Jayden and Manki, Eric, Hubert and Gary Law. Admission is free and no advance booking is required for the evening sets, though the organisers have noted an RSVP option for the opening gathering. The venue is at 11A–11D Hart Avenue.
The festival continues a programme that previously ran in May, offering acoustic covers, original songs and small-group performances in an outdoor-adjacent setting open to passers-by.

zh.headline: Cornershop街頭音樂節重返尖沙咀 本周六起免費本地演出
zh.dek: 赫德道The Cornershop一連四個星期六舉辦免費現場音樂，今日下午先有開幕活動，晚上兩節由本地音樂人演出。
body: Cornershop街頭音樂節今日重返尖沙咀，在Mondrian Hong Kong對面的赫德道臨街空間舉行免費本地音樂演出。
由Mondrian Hong Kong主辦，活動於11月7日、14日、21日及28日四個星期六進行。今日下午5時至6時先有開幕活動，參演音樂人預計帶來短篇互動演出；其後晚上6時至8時由Vinky BB演出，8時15分至10時15分則由Kamiel及Ka Long接力。
隨後星期六的陣容包括J Hei、Be、潼潼聯同Jayden及Manki、Eric、Hubert及Gary Law等本地音樂人。入場免費，晚上演出毋須預約；主辦方表示開幕活動設有RSVP選項。場地地址為赫德道11A至11D號。
是次音樂節延續五月曾舉辦的系列，以原音翻唱、原創歌曲及小型組合演出為主，在開放空間讓途人停留欣賞。
